messages:
emily: Quick heads up team 11 final social play for the webinar next Wed. Need LinkedIn + X captions, one hero per platform, and a seeded posting plan by EOD tomorrow. Can we lock copy and times?

jordan: I can draft 3 caption variants + produce 2 hero crops (16:9 for LN, 1:1 for X). Will drop assets in /marketing/launch/assets first thing.

emily: captions must cover: 1) product benefit hook, 2) short benchmark line (latency/cost), 3) strong CTA to register. Also need an ultra-short 280-char opener for the X thread starter.

jordan: noted. single or platform-specific images?

emily: platform-specific please. LN gets explanatory overlay, X gets bold one-liner overlay.

sam: Scheduling suggestion: primary post 10am PT (engagement sweet spot), 24hr reminder at same time, and a 3-hour pre-show bump. Paid funnel sync matches that.

tia: Benchmarks: want to call out ~2.3x throughput and ~40% lower per-token cost on Dedicated, but product signoff needed.
jordan: i'll leave placeholders like "~2x throughput" until we get approval.
emily: tia, can you propose 2 short bench lines we can A/B test? Keep short and social-friendly.

tia: Two options:
- "Real-world: 2x throughput + 40% lower per-token cost. See the data in our webinar."
- "Faster inference, lower spend 1 demo + benchmarks in our webinar."

emily: We'll A/B test option 1 and a variant of 2.

michael: For links: use utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_apr2024. Redirect to /webinar/launch-apr2024 and append ?seed=SEEDNAME for seeded cohorts so SDRs can identify.

emily: exactly. SDRs: tag inbound as "social_x" in CRM for X-sourced registrants.

sam: SDR routing plan: seeded cohort -> #sdr-inbound priority queue; organic -> normal nurture list. sdr-bot will post top-5 signups to #sdr-inbound with UTMs.

sdr-bot: (automated) Will post: "New webinar signups 1 campaign: launch_apr2024 1 top 5: [list]" to #sdr-inbound and ping the on-call SDR.

jordan: uploaded assets: hero_ln_overlay.png, hero_x_bold.png, captions_drafts.txt in /marketing/launch/assets. Also added suggested alt text.

emily: thanks. Can someone write 2 quick follow-up DM templates for X registrants? Short, human, and tailored depending on whether they attended.

sam: DM Attended: "Hey {{first_name}} 1 thanks for joining! Any part of the demo you want a deeper dive on? Happy to connect you with an engineer."

sam: DM No-show: "Hey {{first_name}} 1 sorry we missed you live. We just sent the recording 1 anything you'd like us to highlight in a quick follow-up?"

emily: great. Add both to the SDR handoff doc and include CRM mapping for source + seed.

tia: Analytics ask: create a custom event "thread_engagement_click" with tweet_id param so we can identify which caption/tweet drove conversions. Also capture organic vs seeded seed param.
jordan: propose a 3-tweet X thread structure: opener (hero + hook), stat card (bench), CTA (register + short cadence). I'll post a draft tonight.

emily: accessibility: we need alt text and high contrast checks on heroes. Jordan, can you run that?
jordan: will do alt text and tweak color contrast if needed 1 will note changes in the asset folder.

michael: I'll sync with eng ops to confirm landing capacity and add the canonical UTM+redirect to the calendar invite.

emily: deadline recap: by EOD tomorrow -> final captions, assets uploaded, UTMs confirmed, seedlist routing doc updated, SDR DM templates added. Post final schedule in #marketing at 9am the day of posting. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
